text:
Maria: Heads-up — release CI failed on publish because typegen regendiff popped up on the sample app. Error looks like a changelog/semver mismatch + an auth retry header ordering diff. 😕
Devon: Ugh, I saw that too. CI job: `ci/typegen-check` -> regendiff non-empty. My local `yarn regen` shows only ordering noise on enums and an extra optional param.
Sam: Can you paste the regendiff?
Devon: Sure — short snippet:
```
-   "retry": { "maxAttempts": 2, "backoffMs": 100 }
+   "retry": { "backoffMs": 100, "maxAttempts": 2 }
-   "changelog": "2.0.0\n-Added X"
+   "changelog": "2.0.0\n-Added X\n"
```
Devon: Also one generated interface gained `authToken?: string` in a different order which triggers our stable-sort check.
Maria: CI-bot posted the failure in the release pipeline: `typegen-regendiff` stage failed. It blocks npm publish.
CI-bot: deploy/job/4521 — typegen-regendiff FAILED — artifact: regendiff/summary.txt attached.
Jen: Related: sample app onboarding is flaky because our auth/retry default param was moved from client constructor to call options. New SDKs ask for token on each call which breaks quickstart.
Sam: That explains the e2e failure I hit — sampleapp docker init used `new Client({})` expecting K/V from env, now throws missing auth param in generated types.
Devon: My hypothesis: prettier/serializer bump in the codegen pipeline changed key ordering for generated JSON (we rely on deterministic property order to avoid regendiff). Semver patch bumped type hashes.
Maria: Action items? I'm thinking: (1) revert serializer bump in codegen (2) add stable-sort pass in typegen pipeline (3) relax regendiff whitespace checks for changelog trailing newline. Thoughts?
Sam: +1 for stable-sort pass. Reverting serializer is risky if other teams rely on it.
Jen: Add a small migration in sampleapp quickstart to tolerate token in call options OR prefer env fallback to avoid blocking onboarding.
Devon: I'll prepare a hotfix PR that: pins serializer, adds stable-sort for enum/property deterministic emit, and updates changelog trimming before comparison. Will run `ci/typegen-check` locally then push.
Maria: Can you also include a note in the release checklist to run `yarn regen --ci` in sampleapp before publish? We missed that step.
Devon: Yep. I'll include checklist and a CI job to run sampleapp regen as a preflight.
Sam: FYI, the auth/retry behavior change came from the auth-retry refactor (PR #3412). Maybe we should add a compatibility test that constructs clients with empty config and makes a mocked call.
Maria: Good call. Add a simple smoke test to sampleapp that runs in CI in <10s. If it fails, block publish.
Jen: I'll update quickstart docs mentioning the auth param location so support doesn't get more tickets today.
Devon: Pushing draft PR now, will tag @Maria @Sam for review. :thumbsup:
CI-bot: PR 4519 created by Devon — checks running: typegen, lint, unit.
Maria: Thanks — if anyone sees other regendiff noise, paste snippets here so we can catch pattern.
Sam: I'll run full regen across SDKs tonight and report any other surprises.
Jen: Great — I can queue the sampleapp smoke test once PR lands.
